## Summary

Describe the decoding, control-flow, LLIL, documentation, or tooling change.

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] Decoder self-test in Binary Ninja, when integration code changed
- [ ] LLIL coverage report reviewed, when lifting code changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible behavior

## Fixture provenance

Confirm that any included byte sequence is synthetic or freely
redistributable and contains no credentials or private firmware.
